mergearticles-extension-desc: Waxay oggolaanaysaa isbar bardhigga iyo isku darka maqaallada
mergearticles-sp-review: Isku dar bogagga - dib u eeg oo isku dar
mergearticles-sp-compare: Isku dar bogagga - isbarbardhig oo isku dar
mergearticles-merge-success-header: Isku darka bogga waa lagu guulaystay!
mergearticles-merge-new-help: Bogga "$1" weli ma jiro, isku-darkanna wuxuu abuuri doonaa. Fadlan hubi oo, haddii loo baahdo, wax ka beddel nuxurka ka hor inta aan la isku darin.
mergearticles-merge-existing-help: Bogga "$1" hore ayuu u jiray! Fadlan isbar bardhig isbeddellada hoose.
mergearticles-same-block-label: {{PLURAL:$1|$1 qayb isku mid ah|$1 qaybo isku mid ah}} ayaa qarsoon
mergearticles-show-final-text-label: Dhammaan khilaafaadka isku-darka waa la xalliyay, qoraalka ugu dambeeya hadda waa la arki karaa oo, haddii loo baahdo, waa la sixi karaa ka hor isku-darka. Fiiro gaar ah: Halkaan ka dib, khilaafka isku-darka mar dambe lama beddeli karo!
mergearticles-discard-draft-help: Ficilkani wuxuu tirtiri doonaa boggan qabyo ah. Ma hubtaa inaad rabto inaad sii waddo?
mergearticles-no-diff-message: Ma jiro farqi qoraal oo u dhexeeya bogga qabyo iyo bogga bartilmaameedka!
mergearticles-draft-discard-success-text: Bogga $1 si guul leh ayaa loo tuuray
mergearticles-no-content-message: Boggan wax nuxur ah kuma jiro. Nuxurka waxaa lagu dari karaa hoos
mergearticles-no-diff-file-message: Faylka isha ayaa la mid ah faylka bartilmaameedka
apihelp-ma-merge-page-new-summary: Waxay ku daraa nooc qabyo ah bog cusub
apihelp-ma-merge-page-existing-summary: Waxay ku daraa nooc qabyo ah bog jira
apihelp-ma-set-related-titles-summary: Waxay bogga la xiriirisaa nooc qabyo ah oo bogga ah
apihelp-ma-discard-draft-summary: Tuur nooca qabyo ee jira ee bogga
mergearticles-apihelp-param-skipfile: Bool. Deji haddii faylasha laga boodayo
mergearticles-apihelp-param-relatedto: Integer. Aqoonsiga bogga, bogga la bixiyay waa in loo dejiyaa inuu la xiriira
